stemMd: Which expression has a rational value?
explanationMd: The quotient is the square root of 18/2, or the square root of 9, which equals 3. The other expressions are nonzero rational multiples of the square root of two.

distractorRationale.b: The difference is twice the square root of two, still irrational.
distractorRationale.a: The sum is four times the square root of two, which is irrational.
distractorRationale.d: Dividing this irrational number by a nonzero rational preserves irrationality.
